readback.name: Poincare.DeTurckChartLift.chartLift_contMDiff
readback.mathematical_statement:
Every smooth compactly supported real bilinear coefficient field on Euclidean three-space whose closed support lies in the genuine preferred-chart target yields a globally smooth section of the actual tangent bilinear-form bundle by pullback through the forward chart differential and zero extension outside the chart source.

M is arbitrary Type u, with TopologicalSpace, T2Space, ChartedSpace E, and IsManifold I infinity; E = EuclideanSpace real (Fin 3), I = closedSmoothModelWithCorners 3 = real boundaryless three-dimensional model.

Bilin = E →L[real] E →L[real] real, with the canonical Euclidean/operator norm and topology; all scalar structures are over real.

anchor is any point of M; F is an arbitrary E-to-Bilin map with ContDiff real infinity F, HasCompactSupport F, and tsupport F contained in extChartAt I anchor target.

At x, A_x = mfderiv I (modelWithCornersSelf real E) (extChartAt I anchor) x. The local pullback is the actual tangent bilinear form (v,w) ↦ F(chart(x))(A_x v)(A_x w).

chartLift x is that local pullback if x belongs to the genuine extChartAt source and the zero tangent bilinear form otherwise.

The conclusion is ContMDiff I (I.prod (modelWithCornersSelf real Bilin)) infinity for x ↦ Bundle.TotalSpace.mk' Bilin x (chartLift anchor F x), using the canonical smooth nested hom bundle of the tangent bundle. It is a global statement on M, not an on-source coefficient regularity statement.

On the open chart source, the chart and its tangent map are smooth; composing the smooth coefficient F with the chart and pulling back in both arguments gives a smooth dependent tangent bilinear section.

HasCompactSupport F makes tsupport F compact. Its image under the inverse chart is compact because that inverse chart is continuous on the true target, and the support is wholly in that target. T2Space M makes this transported compact set closed and it lies inside the chart source.

Off that closed transported support, chartLift is locally the zero bundle section; this gives smoothness at source-boundary and outside-source points. The two open regions cover M.

The theorem assumes neither a coordinate equality nor a support identity. Such bridges must be derived from the actual definitions if needed; no symmetry, positivity, ellipticity, Riemannian metric, compactness of M, connectedness, or second-countability assumption is present or needed.

The frozen statement does not assert existence of nonzero F, Ricci or DeTurck evolution, a metric, or Poincare completion.
